☛ Track time/sequence clues (e.g., 'June and July' in C, 'After that' in B).

☛ Ensure pronoun references (e.g., 'they' in B) align with prior sentences.

☛ यह arrangement 'email → office call → worry → reason' के logical flow को follow करता है।

Rearrangement Strategy:
☛ Opening sentence ढूंढें जो context set करे (यहाँ A)।
☛ Pronoun references (जैसे 'She' in C) को पहचानें और उन्हें previous sentence से link करें।
☛ Cause-effect या timeline (D में past incident) को sequence में रखें।
☛ Paragraph को पूरा पढ़कर check करें कि यह 'coherent' है।

Full Sentence:
A. On the last day of the training, I received an e-mail from my training manager, Jane.
C. She had called me to her office.
B. I wondered if I had done anything wrong.
D. Once I had skipped classes to watch a movie and a football game.
